title: Open CMT Gene Table
description:
Genes linked to Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease (CMT) and related inherited neuropathies, one row per ClinGen gene-disease curation, with the subtype names that go with each rating, inheritance, GeneReviews and PanelApp links, registered drug trials and a plain-language note. Every hand-checked value carries a source URL.

Explained and footnoted at cmt.blog/cmt-gene-table. Browse and download at dknauss.github.io/cmt-gene-table. Built from ClinGen (CC0) and the Mondo Disease Ontology (CC BY 4.0). General information, not medical advice.
